001package services;
002
003import base.User;
004import enums.Role;
005
006/**
007 * Singleton authentication service: login, logout, and role checks.
008 */
009public class AuthService {
010    private static AuthService instance;
011    private User currentUser;
012
013    private AuthService() {}
014
015    public static AuthService getInstance() {
016        if (instance == null) {
017            instance = new AuthService();
018        }
019        return instance;
020    }
021
022    public boolean login(String login, String password) {
023        Database db = Database.getInstance();
024        User user = db.findUserByLogin(login);
025
026        if (user != null && user.checkPassword(password)) {
027            currentUser = user;
028            Logger.log("User logged in: " + login);
029            return true;
030        }
031
032        Logger.log("Failed login attempt: " + login);
033        return false;
034    }
035
036    public void logout() {
037        if (currentUser != null) {
038            Logger.log("User logged out: " + currentUser.getLogin());
039            currentUser = null;
040        }
041    }
042
043    public User getCurrentUser() {
044        return currentUser;
045    }
046
047    public boolean isLoggedIn() {
048        return currentUser != null;
049    }
050
051    public boolean hasRole(Role role) {
052        return currentUser != null && currentUser.getRole() == role;
053    }
054
055    public boolean isAdmin() {
056        return hasRole(Role.ADMIN);
057    }
058}
